statusDetail: Coverage-complete representative audit of the public Czech homepage, listing, detail, account entry, and error routing surfaces. The age gate and consent state were treated as intentional entry conditions.

findings.summary: Theme is hard-coded rather than preference-aware.
findings.evidence: The preferences probe found color-scheme: normal and no prefers-color-scheme rules; dark and default captures are byte-identical.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and map surfaces through prefers-color-scheme or light-dark() so the browser preference controls the theme.

findings.summary: Route changes have no View Transition treatment.
findings.evidence: The modern CSS probe found no view-transition rules, while the site exposes many MPA detail routes.
findings.suggestedFix: Use cross-document View Transitions for same-origin listing-to-detail navigation, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Navigation chrome does not expose scroll-state adaptation.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no scroll-state queries or scroll-driven navigation affordances on a long feed.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a subtle scroll-state-aware header or progress affordance using CSS scroll-state queries where supported.

findings.summary: Transient UI is positioned with fixed custom CSS rather than anchor positioning.
findings.evidence: DOM CSS shows custom fixed cookie and age overlays; no anchor-name, position-anchor, or position-try rules were found.
findings.suggestedFix: Use semantic popovers and CSS anchor positioning for menus and tooltips, retaining a basic positioned fallback.

findings.summary: Consent and age-gate UI use custom containers instead of native dialog semantics.
findings.evidence: The DOM contains a custom role=dialog age gate and custom cookie wrapper CSS; no native dialog or popover was present.
findings.suggestedFix: Use <dialog> for the modal age gate and a semantic dialog or popover for consent settings, including focus trapping and platform dismissal where appropriate.

findings.summary: Advertising and repeated chrome compete with core content.
findings.evidence: HAR captured 31 TrafficJunky image requests and 1.18 MB from its image origin; visible page text repeatedly inserts advertising removal prompts between cards.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer and consolidate ads, reserve fewer placements, and keep the primary content grid visually dominant.

findings.summary: Components rely on viewport layout rather than container-aware adaptation.
findings.evidence: The modern CSS probe found no @container rules across the loaded styles.
findings.suggestedFix: Adopt container queries for reusable video cards, search, and navigation modules that appear at different widths.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is not visibly indicated on a primary link.
findings.evidence: After focusing the first link, computed style was outline: none and box-shadow: none. Lighthouse also reported label/name issues.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a strong :focus-visible treatment and verify every control through a keyboard-only focus walk.

findings.summary: Unknown URLs silently redirect to the homepage.
findings.evidence: The missing-page probe requested /web-uplift-audit-missing-page but ended at / with HTTP 200 and no error heading or recovery explanation.
findings.suggestedFix: Return a real 404 and a clear localized recovery page with home, search, and back options.

findings.summary: Largest Contentful Paint is slow.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 6.3 s, FCP 3.3 s, Speed Index 5.3 s, and Time to Interactive 10.3 s; trace LCP was 13.2 s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the age-gate/LCP visual, reduce document and tag-manager latency, and defer below-fold work.

findings.summary: The narrow layout shifts during load.
findings.evidence: The 360x800 layout observer recorded CLS 0.102 with a 0.102 shift at about 5.9 s; Lighthouse measured CLS 0.09.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve dimensions for late content, consent UI, images, and ad slots before they load.

findings.summary: The initial page is network-heavy and has a long critical chain.
findings.evidence: HAR captured 178 requests and 5.49 MB transferred, including 11 stylesheets, 40 scripts, and multiple parser-inserted high-priority resources.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce document duplication, inline only critical CSS, defer non-critical scripts and styles, and apply useful cache headers.

findings.summary: Third-party and script cost dominates too much of the initial load.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 107 third-party requests, 2.61 MB third-party transfer, and 40 scripts; Google Tag Manager alone transferred about 468 KB.
findings.suggestedFix: Audit script coverage, remove duplicate tag-manager destinations, and conditionally load ads and analytics after consent and need.

findings.summary: Advertising frames and controls lack reliable accessible names.
findings.evidence: axe reported serious frame-title violations across many ad iframes; Lighthouse also reported visible-label/accessibility-name mismatches.
findings.suggestedFix: Give functional iframes concise titles, hide decorative frames from assistive technology, and align accessible names with visible labels.

findings.summary: Landmarks, heading hierarchy, and focus treatment are incomplete.
findings.evidence: axe reported page content outside landmarks; the homepage has no H1; the focused link had no outline or shadow.
findings.suggestedFix: Add main/nav landmarks and a logical H1 hierarchy, then implement and test persistent :focus-visible styles.

findings.summary: User zoom and media equivalents are not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed the meta-viewport user-scaling audit, and the representative video had no caption or description tracks.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove maximum-scale/user-scalable restrictions and provide caption tracks or equivalent transcripts for meaningful video.

findings.summary: The page logs browser errors.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed the console-errors audit on the tested homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve the reported runtime and network errors, and make a clean console a release gate.

findings.summary: Image delivery is not consistently robust or efficient.
findings.evidence: The images primitive found 3 images without dimensions, 33 without srcset, and 18 in legacy formats.
findings.suggestedFix: Add intrinsic dimensions, responsive srcset/sizes, and modern formats while preserving existing alt text.

findings.summary: Deprecated APIs and browser integration issues remain.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported 2 deprecation warnings, Inspector issues, and 4 BFCache failure reasons.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace deprecated APIs, address DevTools Issues findings, and remove avoidable unload or cache blockers.

findings.summary: Public templates use a generic title and no meta description.
findings.evidence: Homepage, listing, and detail probes all returned title Pornhub; description was absent, even on the specific video detail URL.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate unique localized titles and descriptions for home, listing, and detail templates.

findings.summary: Important links and robots signals are not crawlable.
findings.evidence: The listing probe counted 18 javascript: links; robots meta is noindex,nofollow and Lighthouse failed crawlable anchors and robots.txt with 4,071 errors.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace scripted anchors with real URLs and publish a valid, intentional robots policy for this locale.

findings.summary: Localized and detail URLs collapse to homepage indexing signals.
findings.evidence: The detail URL canonical points to the homepage, has no hreflang, carries noindex,nofollow, and /sitemap.xml returned 404.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit self-referencing canonicals, valid hreflang links, an XML sitemap, and consistent locale-specific robots directives.

findings.summary: The video detail lacks structured and social metadata.
findings.evidence: The detail probe found no JSON-LD and no Open Graph tags despite a visible named video entity.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate VideoObject JSON-LD and Open Graph/Twitter metadata derived from visible content.

findings.summary: Transport is HTTPS but baseline browser defenses and cookie flags are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Headers show no CSP or nosniff; cookie audit found an rp cookie without Secure and all 7 cookies flagged with SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP, add nosniff, and set Secure plus the narrowest appropriate SameSite value on cookies.

findings.summary: The initial load exposes a large tracking and advertising surface.
findings.evidence: Tracker capture found 12 third-party origins including Google Tag Manager and DoubleClick; HAR recorded 107 third-party requests and 2.61 MB transferred.
findings.suggestedFix: Load only essential services before consent, reduce tracker count, batch analytics, and document each third party and purpose.

findings.summary: The exposed sign-in surface does not show phishing-resistant authentication.
findings.evidence: The login probe was redirected to the homepage and found no WebAuthn or PublicKeyCredential integration, while the site prominently exposes sign-in.
findings.suggestedFix: Expose passkey sign-in and registration alongside recovery, and request any permissions only after a clear user action.

findings.summary: Several defensive response policies are absent.
findings.evidence: Headers include HSTS and SAMEORIGIN, but lack Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, CSP/frame-ancestors, and nosniff.
findings.suggestedFix: Add least-privilege Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy plus CSP frame-ancestors and content restrictions.

findings.summary: Only part of the rendered content survives without JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Discoverability measured 39% rendered-word coverage in raw HTML. The page is not an empty shell, but most rendered words are absent without JS.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render core listing and detail content and layer interactivity on top as progressive enhancement.

findings.summary: The app-like video service has a service worker but no manifest link.
findings.evidence: The listing probe found service-worker support but no web app manifest.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a standards-compliant web app manifest and a deliberate offline fallback for shell and saved metadata.

findings.summary: Failure routing hides errors instead of explaining recovery.
findings.evidence: An unknown URL returned homepage content with HTTP 200 and no not-found state.
findings.suggestedFix: Return correct status codes and localized error states with retry, search, and navigation recovery.

findings.summary: The Czech locale declares an invalid language code.
findings.evidence: The document uses lang=cz; axe and Lighthouse both flagged it as invalid. Czech should use the BCP 47 code cs.
findings.suggestedFix: Set lang=cs, add valid hreflang values, and test reading order and logical properties.

findings.summary: Localization is inconsistent within the Czech experience.
findings.evidence: Visible Czech pages contain substantial untranslated English UI and content labels, and no hreflang alternatives were emitted.
findings.suggestedFix: Route all interface strings through a localization layer and format locale-sensitive values with Intl APIs.

findings.summary: The sign-in route does not provide a stable, inspectable account entry state.
findings.evidence: Navigating to /login redirected to the homepage and exposed only the search form behind consent and age gating.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a stable localized account entry URL, clear authentication choices, and findable account/subscription management.

findings.summary: Image assets are not broadly responsive or modern.
findings.evidence: Image audit found 33 of 37 images without srcset, 18 legacy-format images, and 3 missing dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve responsive AVIF/WebP sources with width, height, sizes, and lazy loading below the fold.

findings.summary: The initial page performs disproportionate network work.
findings.evidence: The initial gate and hidden feed triggered 178 requests and 5.49 MB, including 107 third-party requests before the core task proceeds.
findings.suggestedFix: Delay feed, advertising, and analytics requests until after consent and age entry; cancel work for obscured content.

findings.summary: Third-party advertising exceeds a proportionate initial-load budget.
findings.evidence: Third parties transferred 2.61 MB; TrafficJunky alone made 31 image requests and transferred 1.18 MB while an age gate covered the content.
findings.suggestedFix: Set an explicit third-party budget, lazy-load ads after the gate, and remove low-value placements and duplicate analytics.
